name: MayankSinha
introMessage1: I'm Mayank Sinha, a Java Developer with 5 years of experience building robust, scalable, and high-performance backend systems and enterprise applications.
introMessage2: I specialize in Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, RESTful APIs, and SQL databases. Over the years, I've contributed to full software development lifecycles—from architecture and design to deployment and optimization—helping teams deliver clean, maintainable code in fast-paced environments.
introMessage3: I'm passionate about writing efficient backend services, system design, and integrating modern DevOps practices like CI/CD and containerization with Docker and Kubernetes. Outside of work, I enjoy exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, and learning about system architecture and software craftsmanship.
